primary_source.main_relation: candidate pin is one commit behind observed main; the intervening commit changes only kernel_engineering stage/test files, not the audited venue/prompt path

verification_level: exact pinned primary-source static code-path verification; no live upstream runtime replay was performed

findings.claim: The generic role prompt catalog is intentionally dual-root: project_root is the state/control root while altitude_root is the worktree. Vertical prompt fragments use altitude_root, but enabled stage/full-pipeline checklist formatting receives project_root.

Reviewer construction supplies vertical_state_root as project_root and working_dir as altitude_root, and normally requests AUTO checklist mode for a persisted campaign. Therefore the Reviewer directly exercises the split-root checklist path.

For research venue-dependent stages, checklist rendering calls resolve_venue_profile on the checklist project_root. A non-built-in target needs a matching local research/VENUE_PROFILE.json on that same root; if absent, rendering appends a fail-closed venue.profile item.

Manager vertical commitment persists target_venue into the Manager project/state root, while deterministic stage completion accepts a separate evidence_root and calls the vertical validator on the evidence/work root with state_root retained separately. This makes prompt/checklist semantics and deterministic evidence validation capable of observing different roots.

Research venue preparation/research is workdir-rooted and writes research/VENUE_PROFILE.json in the workdir. The explicit venue checklist and venue-research tests inspected are single-root and do not cover manager_state_root != execution_workdir with a dynamic venue profile only in the workdir.

The direct Engineer SkillLoop mission_request passes state root plus altitude_root but leaves RolePromptRequest.checklist_mode at its default NONE. Therefore this audit does not verify that this specific Engineer mission-request path receives the unresolved venue checklist. The Reviewer path is directly verified; Planner and any other Engineer checklist-injection path remain separate questions.

Venue research itself reads target_venue from the workdir pipeline state, whereas Manager commit persists target_venue in the Manager state root. This audit did not fully trace the state migration/projection that must make the selected target available in the workdir before venue research. Thus an end-to-end production failure is not claimed.

scope_guard: Evidence supports a source-level split-root inconsistency for dynamic non-built-in venue rendering, directly on Reviewer checklist construction, not a reproduced live campaign failure and not a claim that all role prompts are affected. Built-in venues can resolve from target_venue alone and are outside this dynamic-profile failure mode.

recommended_regression.workdir: matching valid research/VENUE_PROFILE.json and venue evidence
recommended_regression.current_expected_source_behavior: vertical/worktree facts may resolve from workdir while checklist venue resolution uses state_root and can append unresolved venue.profile; deterministic validation supplied evidence_root=workdir can inspect workdir evidence
recommended_regression.desired_contract: checklist rendering takes an explicit evidence/descriptor root while stage/route authority remains state-rooted; fail closed on profile/authority mismatch
